references.text: The original instruction from God to Moses to join five curtains together, as Exodus 36:10 describes the execution of.
The instruction to use hooks to fasten the curtains together so that the tabernacle becomes a whole.
Continuation of the work of joining the curtains together using gold hooks.
Parallel description of how five curtains were joined together, this time for the goat-hair curtains.
Follows up on the joining of the curtains with details about the loops that allow the tent to become one continuous whole.
Describes the final act where the two curtain pieces from 36:10 are connected into a single unit using bronze hooks.
Thematic parallel showing how both curtains and boards must be joined to form a cohesive unit.
